name: R&R BBQ (Draper / South Jordan / Lehi / Pleasant Grove) Smoked Turkey Breast or Pulled Pork & White Roll
brandOrRestaurant: R&R BBQ (Draper / South Jordan / Lehi / Pleasant Grove, UT)
whyItWorks: With locations right near TownePlace Suites Draper, South Jordan/Herriman, and Pleasant Grove/Lehi (near BambooHR), R&R's slow-smoked Turkey Breast and Pulled Pork are tender, low-fiber proteins when ordered with sauce on the side and a soft dinner roll.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Single Meat Plate with Smoked Turkey Breast or Pulled Pork (BBQ sauce on the side) paired with a soft dinner roll and smooth mashed potatoes or mac & cheese (with lactase).
watchOuts: Skip the spicy Kielbasa sausage, red-pepper hushpuppies, raw cabbage coleslaw, and baked beans
